items.proposed_value: APPEND: On 2026-08-26 Paradromics announced an FDA approval letter expanding the Connect-One EFS so participants can use compatible personal, internet-connected laptops, tablets and phones through its Convey software, without device-by-device FDA sign-off once an agreed deployment and testing process is complete. This widens the network-facing surface of an investigational implant; neither the company release nor trade coverage contains a security statement. On 2026-09-14 the company reported real-time decoding of attempted and imagined speech from intracortical recordings in its one implanted participant (self-chosen sentences, example sentences decoded without error); no accuracy, vocabulary size, speech rate or durability figures were reported and the result is company-reported, not peer-reviewed. ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07357428: Recruiting, estimated enrollment 2. William J. Marks Jr. named Chief Clinical Officer 2026-07-07. Verified 2026-10-06 via paradromics.com/news, ClinicalTrials.gov.
items.rationale: Two company milestones after the baseline; the personal-device expansion is security-relevant.

proposed_value.label: Paradromics receives FDA approval letter to use personal internet-connected devices in Connect-One study

items.rationale: Regulatory milestone with security relevance.

items.proposed_value: regulatory_compliance
items.rationale: Boston Scientific publishes a product-security responsible disclosure process (Revision AC, 2025-02-17): product.security@bsci.com, acknowledgment within five business days, scope includes implants and mobile apps, states no bug bounty. Enum mapping is a human decision.

items.proposed_value: REPLACE 'No BCI-specific published security posture.' with: Company-wide product security program with a published responsible disclosure process (acknowledgment within five business days; no bug bounty); nothing specific to the Vercise DBS line found. APPEND (corporate IT, not device-level): on 2026-08-25 Boston Scientific identified unauthorized activity that caused a network outage affecting manufacturing, order processing and shipping; its Form 8-K Item 1.05 (report dated 2026-09-07) says the incident is likely to be material to Q3 and full-year 2026 results and that no evidence of ongoing unauthorized access was found. The filing does not identify any effect on implanted devices or programmers. Verified 2026-10-06 via SEC EDGAR, bostonscientific.com.
items.rationale: Disclosed incident after the baseline, plus a correction to the posture note.

proposed_value.label: Boston Scientific discloses cybersecurity incident disrupting manufacturing and shipping (Form 8-K Item 1.05)

items.rationale: Disclosed incident at a DBS manufacturer; corporate IT, no device impact stated.

proposed_value.name: Phantom Neuro
proposed_value.security_notes: Peripheral, not cortical: Phantom X is a sensor array implanted beneath the skin of the residual limb that reads neuromuscular signals to control a prosthesis. On 2026-04-17 the company announced approval to start CYBORG, a first-in-human early feasibility study in Melbourne (up to 10 participants with below-elbow amputation; surgery at Cabrini Health); the approving body was not named. Security posture NOT ASSESSED in this pass (default value). Founding year, headquarters and funding not confirmed. New entry proposed 2026-10-06.

proposed_fields.reason: The current enum cannot represent a company that publishes a vulnerability disclosure process but no other security documentation (Neuralink) and blurs it with regulatory compliance for Medtronic, Boston Scientific and LivaNova.
Lets each posture value point to the page that supports it, so 'none_published' can be distinguished from 'not assessed'.
Corporate incidents (Medtronic Apr 2026, Abbott Jul 2026, Boston Scientific Aug 2026) are currently free text in security_notes.
Neurotech Futures (2026-02-03) splits 2025 into therapeutic '$4+B across 100 deals' and analytic '$941m across 41 deals'; deal counts sum to 141 against the headline 140.
ClinicalTrials.gov IDs were the most reliable evidence for units_deployed and status in this pass.
